sources.title: luispoveda93/MiniCPM5-1B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: About this model MiniCPM5-1B is a compact 1B decoder-only model from OpenBMB (standard LlamaForCausalLM), built for local assistants, coding agents, and tool use, with a hybrid <think> chat mode and long-context support.

sources.title: GitHub - OpenBMB/MiniCPM: MiniCPM5: SOTA on-device LLMs, small yet ...
sources.snippet: We are releasing MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in the MiniCPM5series, following MiniCPM5-1B. It is a dense 2B Transformer that scales up the same training recipe, built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 2B-class open-source SOTA.
